# QS-CFW-6874-71 - Quality specification - gear blank CFW-6874-71 (8620)
Revision: Rev C (supersedes Rev B)  
Plant: P1  
Parts: CFW-6874-71

Scope
This quality specification defines acceptance criteria and inspection methods for gear blank CFW-6874-71. It applies to forged blanks produced at Plant P1 and covers dimensional tolerances, hardness, and maximum forging weight for delivery to machining operations.

Requirements table
| Feature | Specification | Acceptance |
|---|---:|---|
| Material and part | CFW-6874-71 gear blank | Conforming to purchase drawing |
| Hardness | 41-44 HRC. | Within specified range across tooth root and web areas |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.07 mm. | Measured at finished bore, concentricity per drawing |
| Maximum forging weight | 130.4 kg. | Blank weight must not exceed this value at cool-down handoff |

Inspection method
Hardness shall be measured using a calibrated Rockwell tester following standard laboratory procedures. Measure at representative locations indicated on the inspection drawing; record values and verify they fall within 41-44 HRC. Bore diameter tolerance shall be measured with a calibrated bore gauge or internal micrometer and recorded; all measurements must be traceable. Weigh the forged blank on a calibrated scale at the first permanent identification point and confirm the result does not exceed 130.4 kg. Calibration records for measurement equipment must be available at the time of inspection.

Nonconformance handling
Suspect or nonconforming items shall be quarantined and labeled to prevent unintended use. Document nonconformances in the ERP system and notify quality engineering. Disposition options include rework to drawing limits where feasible, use-as-is with engineering approval, or scrap. Reinspection after corrective action must verify that hardness, bore diameter tolerance, and maximum forging weight conform to this specification before release. Records of disposition and final verification shall be retained with the lot file.
